elaine: Heads-up: during the late-night base-image rebuilds (02:00 UTC window) audit-shipper started failing with permission errors and a large backlog.

rohit: I saw the alert 74: audit-shipper queue depth spiking on pagerduty. Any recent access policy changes?

carla: we deployed the new keystore policy and rotated a secondary signing key at 01:50. policy tightened a few verbs around keystore:decrypt / keystore:list.

build-bot: deploy-log: `reconcile keystore-policy v3 -> success`

elaine: logs from audit-shipper: ```
[02:06:21] audit-shipper ERROR write failed err="403: permission denied" target="/keystore/v1/publickeys" queue=4300
[02:06:55] audit-shipper WARN retrying batch size=200
[02:07:10] audit-shipper ERROR backpressure queue=9200
```

rohit: 403 on publickeys -> suggests we removed public-read or get access for the shipper principal. Which principal does audit-shipper use?

carla: it runs as `svc:auditing/audit-shipper@prod`. Policy authorizations show the new role only grants `keystore:verify` but scoped to resource `signer/*`. Looks like we inadvertently dropped a `keystore:get-public` grant for the auditing service.

elaine: that's rough. We have a backlog of ~10k events. Can we grant a scoped temporary exception so it can read public keys again and drain?

carla: yes. I can apply a short-lived binding now: `keystore.public_read -> svc:auditing/audit-shipper@prod (ttl=20m)`. Will do minimal scope: resource=keystore:publickeys, action=get.

sec-bot: policy-change recorded: change_id=pc-8292 actor=carla scope=keystore.public_read ttl=20m

rohit: while that helps, we need to update runbooks and make this less fragile. Suggest: 1) add explicit `keystore.get-public` to audit-shipper role; 2) separate key rotation from RBAC tightening; 3) add automated verification test in the canary pipeline that exercises keystore reads from dependent services.

elaine: Agreed. Short term: pause new base-image rebuilds to avoid further backlog growth. build-bot: can you hold rebuilds?

build-bot: Pausing rebuild workers: reason="audit-shipper-backpressure" will retry check in 10m.

carla: exception pushed at 02:12 UTC. audit logs show reauth success: ```
[02:13:01] audit-shipper INFO reauth OK
[02:13:05] audit-shipper INFO flush progress drained=4200 remaining=5100
```

elaine: good. For follow-up:
- carla: propose and PR a least-privilege role for audit-shipper that includes keystore:get-public and verification-only semantics (terraform + IAM policy snippet)
- rohit: update the deploy checklist and the canary job to run a post-rotate smoke test that performs keystore reads from a representative service principal
- ops: update the rebuild-runbook: auto-pause if audit-shipper.queue > 5000 and alert with runbook link

carla: I'll post the terraform snippet in eng-security for review. Example snippet I'll include: ```hcl
resource "iam_role_binding" "audit_shipper_keystore_public" {
  role = "keystore.get-public"
  subject = "svc:auditing/audit-shipper@prod"
  scope = "keystore:publickeys"
}
```

rohit: One more note: decouple key rotation and RBAC change windows. When rotating keys we should keep existing access grants until consumers pass the post-rotate smoke. Otherwise we create a race.

elaine: Agreed. Also create an incident retrospective blurb so the oncall knows the root cause: simultaneous key rotation + RBAC tighten removed audit consumer access.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-1421 "audit-shipper access revoked during keystore rotation" assigned to carla/rohit with P2 priority.

carla: PR opened for role + tests. tagging @rohit @elaine for review.

rohit: reviewing now. Once approved we'll schedule a canary and update the pipeline jobs.

elaine: thanks all. Reopening rebuilds once queue < 1000. build-bot will auto-resume.

build-bot: queue now 980 will resume workers in 1m.

elaine: thread summary posted to eng-security: root cause = RBAC scoping removed keystore public-get for audit-shipper during a simultaneous key rotation; mitigation = temporary TTL exception and proposed permanent role + deploy process changes. Closing thread after PR merges. :white_check_mark:
